release_notes: Admin account list (/admin/account) redesigned to a cleaner modern dashboard style matching the preview: 6 stat cards (Total/Active/Suspended/Terminated/Total Packages/Disk Usage), a filter bar (search + package + status dropdowns), and an account table with colored package tags, status dots, disk + bandwidth progress bars, IP address, created date/time, and compact icon action buttons (manage / login-as / unsuspend / suspend / delete / edit). Keeps the collapsible owner-group headers ('Planet Hosts 4 accounts'). Added package + status filters in the controller. Bottom quick-action cards + quick tips panel. Verified live with real data (2.1 GB total disk, per-account usage bars).
